body:
# ATLAZ Vulkan Core

**The essential core framework and performance foundation, featuring optimized Vulkan rendering.**

ATLAZ Vulkan Core is a cutting-edge, utility-focused optimization pack built on Fabric for **Minecraft 1.21.11**. Designed to serve as the ultimate performance engine, this pack completely overhauls how Minecraft handles graphics, world generation, and networking—replacing the aging OpenGL renderer with the modern, high-efficiency **Vulkan API**.

Whether you are looking for a rock-solid, high-FPS baseline to build your own custom modpack or just want to squeeze every single frame out of your hardware, ATLAZ Vulkan Core delivers unmatched stability and smoothness.

## 🚀 Key Features & Optimizations

### 🎮 Next-Gen Graphics Engine
* **Vulkan Integration:** Powered by `VulkanMod` and `Not Enough Vulkan`, the pack bypasses traditional driver overhead, offering massive FPS gains, especially on modern graphics cards and handhelds.
* **Smart Culling:** Uses `EntityCulling` and `MoreCulling` to stop rendering what you can't see, drastically reducing GPU load in busy environments.
* **Smooth Frame Pacing:** `Dynamic FPS` keeps your system cool and efficient, while `Fadeless` eliminates jarring screen transitions.

### 🌍 Hyper-Optimized World & Chunk Loading
* **Multithreaded Chunk Generation:** Fully integrated with `C2ME` (Chunk Map Engine) and `Noisium` to unleash your CPU's multi-core potential, resulting in lightning-fast world generation and seamless exploration.
* **Pre-generation Tools:** Includes `Chunky` for server or local world pre-rendering to eliminate exploration stutter entirely.
* **Memory & Math Efficiency:** `FerriteCore` and `ZFastNoise` significantly reduce RAM usage and optimize background mathematical calculations.

### ⚡ Game Logic & Network Enhancements
* **Server-Grade Client Optimization:** Features `Lithium` and `VMP` (Velocity Multiplayer Protocol) to overhaul game physics, chunk ticking, and internal packet handling.
* **Network Stability:** `Krypton` and `PacketFixer` optimize network traffic, reducing rubberbanding and connection issues on high-speed servers.
* **Cleanup Utilities:** `Let Me Despawn` and `Get It Together Drops` keep entity counts in check, avoiding late-game world lag.

### 🛠️ Quality of Life & Essentials
* Fully featured menu controls with `ModMenu`, `Cloth Config`, and `Yet Another Config Lib`.
* Enhanced keybind management via `Controlling`.
* Built-in precision zooming with `Zoomify`.
* Enhanced visuals with `BetterGrass` and seamless UI monitoring via `FPS Overlay`.

## 📌 Ideal For:
* **Vanilla+ Players** who want the absolute smoothest, lag-free Minecraft experience possible.
* **Modpack Developers** looking for a bulletproof, pre-configured performance core to build upon.
* **Handheld & Laptop Gamers** aiming to maximize battery life and performance via hardware-level Vulkan rendering.

> ⚠️ **Note:** Because this pack swaps the rendering engine to Vulkan, traditional Iris/Sodium shader setups will not work out of the box. Ensure your graphics drivers are fully updated for the best Vulkan performance!
